```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
nombres <- c("Samuel Linares",
             "Halena Ruiz",
             "José Manuel Suárez",
             "Gustavo Moreno",
             "IGNACIO GONCALVES",
             "Eidiusca Figueira",
             "Victor Delgado",
             "Angel Hernández",
             "Alfredo Tiapa",
             "Leonardo Crespo",
             "Roselyn Lara",
             "Jonathan Pérez",
             "Dolly Laynes Castrillo",
             "Raúl Cardozo",
             "Alexandra Gómez",
             "Jesús Borges",
             "Yorman Zabala" ,
             "Carlos Morillo")

ci <- c(29658512,
        29756414,
        28210812,
        28306246,
        27600050,
        27669710,
        27531901,
        27995146,
        30037872,
        26260451,
        30138648,
        27487707,
        29686193,
        27660553,
        29768256,
        29815277,
        18440447,
        29521323)
participantes <- tibble(Nombre= str_to_title(nombres),
                        ci= ci)%>%
  arrange(nombres)%>%
   mutate(ci=format(ci, nsmall=0, big.mark=".", decimal.mark=',')  )%>%
  rename(`cédula de identidad`=ci)

gt(participantes)

```
